audience: equipment, event and party rental companies that run TapGoods PRO

useCases.title: See which rentals start soon and what is unpaid
useCases.text: List the rentals in a date range, filtered by status or billing status. Open one rental to see its customers, location, products and totals.

useCases.title: Review the rentals of one customer
useCases.text: Filter the rentals by customer or by name, then open one rental to read its products and totals.

useCases.title: Check stock before you confirm a customer
useCases.text: Look up the products and the quantity held for each item at a location. If the location is short, find nearby locations with enough stock for the dates.

useCases.title: Check a location and its pick list status
useCases.text: Read the name, contact email, locale and location code of a location. Then list its pick list statuses for checking items out and in.

useCases.title: Compare product prices across locations
useCases.text: List the rental products of one or more locations, with prices and quantities. Narrow the list with search text or product ids.
